from solution import moving_sums
assert moving_sums('3;1,2,3,4')=='6,9'
assert moving_sums('1;0,5')=='0,5'
assert moving_sums('3;1,2') is None
assert moving_sums('0;1') is None
assert moving_sums('2;10000000,1') is None
assert moving_sums('2;01,1') is None

import re
def moving_sums(s):
 p=s.split(';')
 if len(p)!=2 or not re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*',p[0]) or int(p[0])>100000 or not p[1]:return None
 w=int(p[0]);a=[]
 for x in p[1].split(','):
  if not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*',x) or int(x)>10000000:return None
  a.append(int(x))
 if len(a)<w:return None
 o=[];v=sum(a[:w])
 if v>10000000:return None
 o.append(str(v))
 for i in range(w,len(a)):
  v+=a[i]-a[i-w]
  if v>10000000:return None
  o.append(str(v))
 return ','.join(o)
